verdict.rationale: Reducto offers a single upload-then-Parse flow: an upload returns a reducto:// identifier usable by any endpoint (Parse, Extract, Split, Classify, Edit). Pricing claims "30+ Supported File Types", which suggests no per-format plumbing, but the pack never lists which formats are covered beyond PDF and DOCX (DOCX appears only in the Edit context). missing for 10: an explicit documented format list confirming PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images and email (e.g. EML/MSG), any per-format behavior or limitation docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed-format handling.
